title: Isomorphism
description: JSON Schema for an isomorphism — a morphism f : A → B together with an inverse morphism g : B → A such that g ∘ f = id_A and f ∘ g = id_B (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. I §5). Equivalently, the morphism that witnesses two objects' indistinguishability under the Yoneda principle. Specializes transformer by carrying an additional inverse cell; the round-trip-equals-identity laws are categorical equations checked by separate transformers.

inverse.description: The inverse morphism g : B → A. The pair (this isomorphism, inverse) satisfies g ∘ f = id_A and f ∘ g = id_B; these round-trip-equals-identity laws are checked by the isomorphism-witness transformer, not by the schema.
